finding: We tested whether repeated noisy replies add predictive information when their sources are independent or copied. All 551 deterministic files match across the original run and both complete replays. Independent numerical reconstruction is source admitted after 18 isolated controls; predictive rankings remain unaccepted. This is a supplied-law constructed-method comparison, not evidence of learned access, process correspondence or human intent.
